snippet.title: Pokémon TCG Pocket: Fantastical Parade | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Come one and all to the Fantastical Parade! ✨ Join in the fun with this upcoming Pokémon TCG Pocket expansion with even more to add to your collection. 

Mark your calendars—Fantastical Parade launches Wednesday, January 28! 🥁

Find all your favorite Pokémon merchandise at the official Pokémon Center: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/
